::: {#perfil}

He holds a BSc in Applied Mathematics from FGV EMAp, is a laureate of the
CAPES Talento Universitário award, and a multi-medalist in the OBMEP math
olympiad. He works as a data scientist at BNDES; previously, he worked at
the Energy Research Office (EPE), SPX Capital, and Americanas.

## Education

- BSc in Applied Mathematics, FGV EMAp.

## Interests

Data science, data mining, and data wrangling.
